04 / GOOD TO KNOW

Before we
begin.

01What does school website development in Etah include?+

The scope can include admissions and parent journey planning, mobile-friendly school website design, notices, forms and content administration. We confirm the first useful release after reviewing the users, workflow and current tools.

02Can school staff update notices and pages?+

Yes. We can provide a controlled administration area and define which staff roles may update each type of content.

03Does WeTakeFWD have to be physically based in Etah?+

No. We can deliver remotely for organisations in Etah. Any on-site work, service area or local presence is described accurately and agreed before the project begins.
